title: Presidential Candidates Face Intense Schedule This Thursday
subtitle: Interviews, Q&A Sessions, Visits, and Rallies Define Candidates' Schedules
excerpt: This Thursday (10), presidential candidates have a busy day: interviews, Q&A sessions, lectures, leaflet distribution, motorcades, rallies, and visits to institutions & social projects.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The schedule for presidential candidates this Thursday (10) includes a variety of campaign activities.

Among the commitments are radio and podcast interviews, Q&A sessions and lectures, in addition to leaflet distribution. A motorcycle rally and a public rally are also planned.

Candidates will also visit institutions, public spaces, and social projects, expanding their presence in different areas of society.

With information from Agência Brasil.
